description:
## Status

Absorbed into fz-tfn.59 because stack creation and the first real implementation commit are one atomic boundary. A clean branch equal to PR #122 cannot create a meaningful new stacked PR, and a padding commit would violate the epic's no-debris rule.

## Preserved requirement

Delete the unused engine-wide DerivationId and JobDerivation scheduler substrate after proving production jobs have one job-owned answer. Preserve exact reads, waits, claims, retraction, rebasing, finality, wake attribution and failed-attempt ownership. Prove lower allocations, hashing and completion work; leave no experiment switch, counter or stale documentation.

Consult fz-tfn.59 for the current stack, TDD, deletion, review, commit, PR and acceptance boundary. This description replaces the former standalone plan; comments and parked experiments are historical evidence only.
title: Absorbed into fz-tfn.59
